newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Livestock analysts estimated Friday's hog slaughter from 325,000 to 352,000 head versus 345,000 a week ago and 362,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter was estimated from 70,000 to 180,000 head versus 23,000 a week ago and 221,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates for Friday ranged from 130,000 to 132,000 head versus 132,000 a week ago and 98,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter was estimated from 60,000 to 95,000 head versus 56,000 a week ago and 98,000 a year ago.
